flavors.notes: starts as noise, ends as flavor

ml-engineer.name: ML Engineer Build
ml-engineer.tagline: You own the pipeline. The pipeline knows.
requirements: 3+ years designing, training, and deploying machine learning models in production environments
Proficiency with PyTorch or TensorFlow and the Python ML ecosystem (scikit-learn, NumPy, pandas)
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines that feed production models
Track record of model evaluation, monitoring, and iteration after deployment
Experience shipping end-to-end ML systems with data and product teams

deep-learning-engineer.name: Deep Learning Engineer Build
requirements: Hands-on experience with CUDA or Triton kernel development and GPU performance optimization
Distributed training experience (data, pipeline, and tensor parallelism) with libraries such as NCCL
Working knowledge of mixed- and low-precision arithmetic (FP16/FP8/INT8) and training stability
Proficiency with PyTorch or JAX and profiling tools for locating bottlenecks
Experience scaling workloads across multi-node GPU clusters

llm-engineer.name: LLM Engineer Build
requirements: Experience fine-tuning large language models (SFT, RLHF, or DPO) and evaluating output quality
Built retrieval-augmented generation systems using vector databases and embedding models
Designed and maintained evaluation pipelines covering quality, safety, and regression testing
Inference optimization experience: quantization, batching, and serving frameworks such as vLLM
Experience with prompt design and agent or tool-orchestration frameworks

forward-deployed-engineer.name: Forward Deployed Build
forward-deployed-engineer.tagline: Consultant, PM, and engineer. Hydration for all three.
requirements: 3+ years shipping production software, including customer-facing or client-embedded work
Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into deployed technical solutions end-to-end
Full-stack proficiency (Python or TypeScript) with API, data-system, and cloud integration experience
Strong communication with technical and executive stakeholders
Willingness to travel to customer sites (25-75%)

research-scientist.name: Research Scientist Build
requirements: PhD in machine learning, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent research experience
Publication record at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, or ICLR
Deep familiarity with modern architectures and training methods; rigorous experimental design
Proficiency with JAX or PyTorch for research prototyping at scale
Ability to take research from idea to reproducible result under deadline

mlops-engineer.name: MLOps Build
mlops-engineer.tagline: Uptime for the humans who keep uptime.
requirements: Experience operating Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP) for ML workloads
Infrastructure-as-code proficiency (Terraform or equivalent) and CI/CD for training and deployment
Built model monitoring, drift detection, and alerting for production systems
Experience managing GPU fleets, job schedulers, and compute cost optimization
Production on-call experience for ML services

data-engineer.name: Data Engineer Build
requirements: Mastery in building data products using generative AI, RLHF, and fine-tuning LLMs
End-to-end experience training, evaluating, testing, and deploying machine learning products at scale
Experience building data pipelines and driving ETL design decisions using disparate data sources
Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, streaming and batch pipelines, vector databases, DBT, BigQuery, BigTable or equivalent, and orchestration tools
Experience running machine learning in parallel environments (distributed clusters, GPU optimization)

vibe-coder.name: Vibe Coder Build
requirements: No requirements
Preferred: ships things
